comments.value: The problem was caused by the tests folder in unity's PPS 2.1. Removing the folder fixed the problem.

details:
This is a bit of a long one, but I'll summarize it here at the top. When I upload a world from a certain project, it successfully uploads and gets listed on my profile, but when I try to join it, I get sent back to home 100% of the time. I've done everything in my power to try and fix it, but nothing's worked so far.

So, let's get into more detail. here's a screenshot of what the log says when I try to join the world.
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/502657121700282370/542001831983841301/unknown.png
the world ID is wrld_2cc9ac52-5986-415e-ae31-7037f730c86f 

As you can see, it's trying to load me into the scene "hit detection test," which is not the scene I published. In fact, as part of trying to fix it, I deleted the scene from my project entirely.

The first thing I tried was a new world ID, same issue. I tried a new vrcworld component, that didn't fix it. I tried reimporting the sdk through unity (right click > reimport) that didn't fix it. As a test, I tried making a new scene with just a flat plane and a vrcworld. Same problem. resetting game flow, put me back in my home world.

so I tried a bit of a scorched earth approach. I backed up the project and deleted the vrcsdk and plugins folders from the scene entirely, then imported them again. queue a list of dozens of errors asking if I was missing an assembly reference, and unity throwing up a fatal error, 
"The file MemoryStream is corrupted! remove it and launch unity again! [position out of bounds!]" 
So I restarted unity, same error. deleted the metadata folder and restarted unity. same error. I'm glad I backed things up because it looks like this project is broken now.

so on the backup for the project, I do a test upload just in case, still broken. I clear out my vrchat cache in appdata, that doesn't fix it. It's at this point I decided to do the patrick star method, take the whole project and push it somewhere else. I created a new pro and did a test upload, empty scene, plane, vrcworld. It uploads correctly and I can get in. so I take my entire previous project except the vrcsdk and plugins folders and put all of it in the assets folder.

I fix the lighting, and for the sake of it, create a new vrcworld object in the world. upload. 
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/485438572397330441/542121433166249995/unknown.png
and now here I am. it appears to be trying to load my most recent successful scene upload no matter what I do. I haven't confirmed this, though. I have to experiment more to get anything conclusive on whether that's true, but that's probably irrelevant in the grand scheme of things.
title: Worlds upload, but fail to load in-game
